company_notes:
Account summary:
- Primary objective: replace brittle keyword search + heuristics with RAG-powered support agent and in-context ticket deflection.
- Corpus: ~12M tickets + KB articles; average doc ~400-600 tokens; cold storage + active hot set of ~1.2M.
- Indexing scale ask: daily delta ingestion (~50k tickets/day), periodic reindex (weekly), incremental updates.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end for top-5 reranked answers <= 300ms (VP Eng said 'can't accept >500ms in steady state').
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query <= $0.005 at expected scale (500 QPS peak for agent traffic; 2k QPS for deflection probes).
- Rerank requirement: high-quality top-5; prefer cross-encoder reranker for final re-score but want ANN candidate generation for latency/cost.
- Hybrid search: need exact-match signals (metadata, ticket status) combined with ANN embeddings. Must support filter-by-fields for SLA-aware routing.
- Model preferences: open embeddings (dense 1536-2048 dim) but open to Redwood-verified quantized models; want ability to pin embedding model for regression tracking.
- Caching: KV/prefix cache for frequent questions (FAQ folding) to keep tail latency down.
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to smaller reranker or heuristic fallback during spikes.
- Compliance: data residency for EU customers, audit logs, retention controls required for legal.
- POC success metrics: recall@5, MRR uplift, cost per served query, 95th latency.
- Quote from CTO on call: 'User wait time is unforgiving — sub-300ms must be our target; we will trade model size for latency if needed.'
